map.由每期现金流、利率与期数求年金现值: Find the present value of an annuity from the periodic cash flow, interest rate and number of periods
map.输入每期现金流 PMT、每期利率 r 与期数 n，求年金现值。: Enter the periodic cash flow PMT, the periodic interest rate r and the number of periods n to obtain the present value of the annuity.
map.📖 查看「由每期现金流、利率与期数求年金现值 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Find the present value of an annuity from the periodic cash flow, interest rate and number of periods" guide
map.r=0 时现值退化为 PMT·n。: When r=0 the present value degenerates to PMT·n.
map.📚 深度解析：年金现值（每期现金流折现）: 📚 In-depth analysis: annuity present value (discounting periodic cash flows)
map.一笔每年稳定现金流 n 年，现在值多少。: A steady annual cash flow for n years: what is it worth today.
map.对比贷款或年金产品的现值成本。: Compare the present-value cost of a loan or an annuity product.
map.把分期收款或养老金等系列现金流折算成当前可比的整笔价值。: Convert a series of cash flows such as installment receipts or a pension into one comparable lump-sum value today.
map.PV = 1000×(1−1.05⁻¹⁰)/0.05 = 1000×7.7217: PV = 1000×(1−1.05⁻¹⁰)/0.05 = 1000×7.7217 ≈ 7722 CNY. That is, 1000 per year for the next 10 years discounted at 5% is worth about 7722 today.
map.每期收 2000 元，期利率 1%，共 36 期: 2000 CNY per period, period rate 1%, 36 periods in total
map.PV=2000×[1−(1.01)⁻³⁶]/0.01≈60215.01 元；名义: PV=2000×[1−(1.01)⁻³⁶]/0.01≈60215.01 CNY; nominally 72000 CNY will be received in future, and the 11784.99 CNY difference is the time value of money.
map.是。同一组现金流，终值是未来值、现值是当前值，互为 (1+i)^n 关系。: Yes. For the same set of cash flows, the future value is the value at a future date and the present value is the value today; they differ by a factor of (1+i)^n.
map.36 期该配月利率还是年利率？: Should 36 periods use a monthly rate or an annual rate?
map.n 与 r 必须同单位：按月收款就填月利率，按年收款就填年利率。36 期配月利率: n and r must share the same unit: use a monthly rate for monthly receipts and an annual rate for annual receipts. 36 periods with a 1% monthly rate means a 3-year term; if you mistakenly use a 1% annual rate (roughly 12% annualized), the present value will be significantly understated.
